title: ETTP Trust Context
description: A bounded set of contextual attributes relevant to an ETTP evaluation.

identity.description: Optional entity identifier relevant to this context.

capability.description: Optional capability name relevant to this context.

environment.description: Optional descriptive AI runtime or deployment environment attributes.

time.description: Optional timestamp associated with this context.

operator.description: Optional identifier of a human or system operator relevant to the context.

resource.description: Optional resource identifier relevant to the context.

extensions.description: Optional implementation-defined context attributes. Extensions must not redefine ETTP protocol fields.
